description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D2x_dirichlet_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=4 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the compound D(D(u,x),x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior 3-point stencil aggregate over columns [2,3] all j; mirror-ghost fixed-value x-faces at i=1 and i=4 carrying the free names gL, gR and dx over the (1 x 4) strips), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
